objective: Canario unitario 1 de Gate 12 Cavas: certificar unicamente si dbo.CavaSocios_Socios.PersonaID existe fisicamente. Sin DDL, sin DML y sin tocar Produccion.

queries.name: persona_id_exists
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS personaid_columns FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.CavaSocios_Socios') AND name=N'PersonaID'
